title: Mind For Music
text: An analysis of how musical genres have evolved across the Billboard Hot 100, comparing all-time chart toppers against every year from 1958 to 2024. You can inspect the complete song-level data on the Explore the data page.

title: Mind For Music
section: Technology & Social Media vs. Music Genre Popularity (1958 – 2024)
text:
Technology & Social Media vs. Music Genre Popularity (1958 – 2024)
How has the rise of personal computing, the internet, social media, and streaming aligned with shifts in musical taste? In the chart below, solid lines represent the annual share of Billboard Top 100 hits for major genres, while dashed lines show technology and social media adoption. Click any genre or technology in the legend to isolate or compare them.

NoteProject Plan

I am also going to find different impactful events from these years or surrounding years and see the impact on the popular genres during that time.
